templates.name: Kettlebell Strength Foundations
templates.description: Six weeks of the big strength patterns from Mastering the Kettlebell — deadlift, squat, press, row, lunge and get up — with a mobility or breathing session between every two lifting days.

templates.name: Swing, Clean & Snatch Technique
templates.description: Six weeks through the ballistic pre-checks and lifts: perform, correct the common faults, then practise. Flexibility work from each pre-check fills the days between.

templates.name: Mobility & Joint Care
templates.description: Four weeks of joint-by-joint mobility from Athleticism 4 Life and the flexibility checks from Mastering the Kettlebell, with a full stretching or ELDOA session each week.

templates.name: Conditioning Engine
templates.description: Six weeks, four sessions a week: Athleticism 4 Life workouts and Kettlebell Lifestyle workout days, each followed by a breathing, Working In or stretching session.

templates.name: Mindset & Presence
templates.description: Eight weeks of The Path to Inspired Action — each week's call and playwork — with a breath or Working In practice between them.

templates.name: Retreat Preparation
templates.description: Four weeks to arrive ready for Men of Movement: the preparation practices, breath capacity (BOLT), Working In and simple movement prep, with a meditation or breath day between sessions.
